chapter_note: The oldest layer here is a compact astrological-cosmological explanation: five time-authorities (year/month/day/hour/moment) installed over the zodiac-sphere, whose changing dominion correlates with the diminishing lifespan/stature of human generations, plus an older-looking biological consequence of “richer light” in the earliest generations (multiple births). The chapter is strongly wrapped in dialogue frame, and the second half shows marked homiletic/application drift (end-times emphasis; moralizing about present humanity), consistent with editorial fatigue.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Dialogue-frame setup (“Once again… catechumen… my master”), with question formula and audience-address; functions as hagiographic apparatus rather than impersonal system exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, no[te] that Adam is mighty in his stature, and great is his size. Even his years are many! He spent many years living in the world. And he is not the only one we have found to be mighty; but all the others who were begotten in his generation, many are their years too. Still, these people who are born today, their stature has been diminished in power; even their years are lessened. Also, why is the birth today, of [the]y who are born, altered compared with that of these first [ ... ] place to place? See, even the stars and signs of the zodiac continue in their positions. Why now have the age and the years of these last ones diminished, and he has also become smaller, compared to these ancient ones who belong to these first generations?
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal explanatory voice anchored in cosmic causes (stars/zodiac) rather than institutional exhortation; “today/now” is comparative but still internal to the cosmological-history schema (decline across generations).

paragraphs.core_text: They increased, have turned, and diminished; because there are five types of authorities and leaders appointed in the sphere of zodiacal signs, and the heavens above it. They have names they are ca[lled] by: the first name is the year; the sec[on]d is the month; the third is the day; the fou[rth] is the hour; the fifth is the moment. Now, these five positions, and these five houses, exist in the sphere and the heavens. These places have five powers, and they are made masters over them. The master of the year exists; the master of the month exists; the master of the day exists; the master of the hour exists; the master of the moment exists. In turn one is above his companion; and in turn the one above is made the master over the one below him.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/dialogue attribution and encomium (“And for his part our enlightener, in his deep wisdom… speaks to this catechumen who had questioned him:”). Kept the systematic fivefold time-authority teaching.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core-like substrate signaled by numbered fivefold structure and impersonal cosmological mechanics (zodiac-sphere/heavens; masters over time-units). Frame material intrudes via attribution/praise formula at the start.

paragraphs.core_text: So, mankind is begotten, and [the ani]mals. They are born in these powers. And, thus, these powers have received authority since the beginning of creation till the end of the world. Now, in the beginning of the generations the powers who were masters over the years reigned. Therefore, because of this, the offspring born in their generations and their lifetime: their years were found to be greater. They attain a long life span in the generation of Adam, and [tha]t of Sethel his son, and that of the ones who came after him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the astrological mechanism: births “in these powers” and a reign-sequence explaining lifespan. Despite “end of the world” phrasing, the paragraph remains causal/systematic rather than hortatory.

paragraphs.core_text: After they ceased to reign, namely the powers who are masters over the years; the powers who are masters over the months themselves reigned. Like the months, for they are less than the years; again this [is] also the case with the offspring w[ho were] born in them. Their life span is less [than the life span of the ones born] in the generation of the powers who master the years!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Iterative, mechanical descent (years → months) correlating a cosmic/time register with embodied lifespan—typical substrate-style process description.

paragraphs.core_text: When the authority of the powers who master the months was completed; the powers of the days received authority after them. Therefore, like the days, for they are less than the months, this also is the case with the offspring who were born in them. Their life span is less than the life span of the ones born in the powers who are masters over the months. Again, even so the offspring who were born in the hours, and of the moments. Their {conduit} is less than that of the months and the days.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the stepped sequence (months → days → hours/moments) in an impersonal explanatory voice; still cosmos→cosmos causality (time-powers → lifespan).

Homiletic/application turn: rhetorical address (“Do you see”), imminent end-times framing, and present-day decline theme (“more than that of today”)—fits the chapter’s second-half drift flagged by the analysis.
Repetitive dialogue frame (“Once again… catechumen… I entreat you, my master!”) summarizing prior lesson; functions as editorial scaffolding.
Question-only transition prompting the next topic (Adam/Eve reproduction). Even without an explicit attribution, its function is dialogic prompting rather than system exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: For the manner of these first generations is that they are richer in their light and purer in stature. Even their years are greater. They were spending a longer time [ ... ] in [the w]omb of their mother. Afterwards, they [ ... ] a number in a single womb. There are times five were brought forth from a single womb, and times six were brought forth from [a] single womb! There are some lesser than this; again, some greater than this. Indeed, because of this the offspring of Eve multiplied, and of her children. The earth was filled by reason of them alone;
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the dialogue attribution and exhortative address (“The enlightener speaks… While well do you ask… know and understand it!”). Removed comparative/application clauses anchoring to the editor’s present (“than the offspring of this tim[e]… differ greatly from those of today… brought forth nowadays…”), keeping the first-generation mechanism-description and exemplification (extended gestation; multiple births; resulting multiplication).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying teaching explains early human fertility as a function of “richer… light” and bodily purity (cosmic substance → biological consequence), but it is embedded in a dialogic and present-comparative preaching layer characteristic of later compilation.
Moralizing denunciation of present people (wickedness, ugliness, suffering, death) with strong “last generations” rhetoric; not systematic cosmological mapping.
Closing homage/thanks formula (“paid homage and gave glory… I thank you, my master”)—typical hagiographic wrap-up, not part of the substrate.
